title: Graphic Skull Tank & Mini Dress
prompt: An original young woman with a sleek black bob and winged eyeliner stands beside a charging station at night, with tall illuminated buildings behind her. She wears a fitted black spaghetti-strap mini dress with a large silver skull graphic across the chest. Black fingerless leather gloves with studs hold a coffee cup, and a black quilted shoulder bag hangs at her side. Her expression is calm and direct. Cool, night-time city light with warm glints. Palette of black, silver, and urban blue. Edgy and bold, in the style of a nightlife street-style photo.
workingNotes:
- The skull graphic and studded gloves are the defining details.
- Keep the graphic abstract to avoid readable text in the image.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the skull graphic abstract, without readable text.
